locations.note: Nancy follows a package from the spy agency Cathedral to learn how her mother Kate died, and ends up defusing the Revenant cell's bomb in Cathedral's server room.
Nancy drops an envelope at the Ten Raven pub.
Nancy hides in Moira's cottage while Moira is abducted, and finds directions to a safehouse in her safe.
Kate's old safehouse cabin opens into a hidden spy room holding her notes.

routes.name: Nancy Drew
routes.note: From Glasgow out to the pub in Giffnock, Moira's cottage in Bearsden and Kate's cabin on Loch Lomond, and back for the bomb.
